svg.title: From Litecoin to LitVM
svg.desc: Intended V2 route. Litecoin: Native LTC. Charms integration: Litecoin ↔ Ethereum interoperability. Ethereum: zkLTC · ERC-20-compatible asset. Arbitrum infrastructure: Ethereum → LitVM. LitVM: zkLTC intended for gas and apps. Intended design; see Network Status.

g.aria-label: zkLTC intended for gas and apps
